wards.notes: Enriched with slum area share + Census 2011 HH-14 amenity proxy (155/200 wards joined by number). Gap Index includes OSM walk_gap when Loaded; mean_walk_min baked for map choropleth.

shelters.notes: Indicates presence of shelters; not a complete stop inventory.

stops.notes: Unofficial community GTFS. Shapes may be straight-line; no suburban rail; no GTFS-RT.

hubs.notes: Union of MRTS stations and metro-tagged GTFS stops. Not a scored equity index.

catchment_400m.notes: Dissolved 400m buffer around GTFS stops. Not population-weighted.

catchment_800m.notes: Dissolved 800m buffer around GTFS stops. Not population-weighted.

omr_corridor.notes: OSM OMR / Rajiv Gandhi Salai (SH49A) toward Mahabalipuram.

metro_area_boundaries.notes: OSM Tambaram & Chengalpattu boundaries + Mahabalipuram study buffer.

corridor_aois.notes: Study AOIs for OMR, Tambaram, Chengalpattu — not official wards.

connectivity_need.notes: OSM major-road segments farther than 400m from a GTFS stop (unmet geometry). High Gap Index wards are boosted in ranking. Inventory only — not ridership or equity.

slums.notes: OpenCity Chennai Slum Boundaries Map (KML). Presence polygons — not income.

bus_stop_audit.notes: CSV for bus shelter data (oorvani/nagariyal as well as ITDP)

tngis_settlement_area.notes: TNGIS settlement area (built-up) via public TNGIS WFS, clipped to CMA study bbox. Inventory context only — not an equity score.

tngis_habitation.notes: TNGIS habitation points via public TNGIS WFS, clipped to CMA study bbox. Inventory context only — not an equity score.

tngis_slum_boundary.notes: TNGIS slum boundary — GetFeature failed (HTTPError). Export from QGIS if you have departmental access.

ward_walk_access.notes: Ward grid samples (~150m) routed on an OSM pedestrian network to the nearest GTFS stop or MRTS/metro hub. mean_walk_min = network metres ÷ 80 m/min (4.8 km/h). OSM walk graph is Partial (missing alleys / sidewalk tags). Not Google Maps, not population-weighted, not an equity score. No crow-flies walk metric.

walk_isochrones.notes: OSM network walk isochrones from existing GTFS stops + MRTS/metro hubs. Bands: ≤5 min, 5–10 min, 10–15 min at 80 m/min (4.8 km/h). Multi-source Dijkstra on osmnx walk graph; node buffers dissolved. Partial — OSM completeness. Not crow-flies; not population-weighted. Proposed metro stations not included.

bus_routes.notes: MTC bus routes from unofficial Chennai GTFS (UngalSoththu). One LineString per route_id × direction from the trip with the most mapped stops. Straight stop-to-stop chords — not road-matched. shapes.txt has no usable bus geometry.
bus_routes.limitation: Crow-flies between consecutive stops; not official MTC path geometry.

facility_pt_walk_links.notes: Crow-flies links from schools/healthcare to nearest PT access point. walk_min_to_pt is OSM network minutes (Partial).

cmrl_phase2_stations.notes: OSM network walk catchment comparison: existing GTFS/hubs vs existing + approximate CMRL Phase II Corridor 5 (Red Line) stations. Station coordinates are curated approximations — not official CMRL CAD. Partial.

cmrl_phase2_line.notes: OSM network walk catchment comparison: existing GTFS/hubs vs existing + approximate CMRL Phase II Corridor 5 (Red Line) stations. Station coordinates are curated approximations — not official CMRL CAD. Partial.

outside_gcc_roads.notes: Outside-GCC unmet roads tagged with OMR / Tambaram / Chengalpattu AOI hints.

coverage_assessment.notes: Unified coverage view for partners/authorities. Combines GCC ward catchments, OSM walk isochrones over GCC∪OMR study area, outside-GCC road gaps, and a Partial CMRL Phase II Corridor 5 (Red Line) walk scenario. No fabricated ridership. Proposed metro coordinates are curated approximations.

walk_beyond_10min.notes: Study area outside ≤10 min OSM walk (Partial).

outside_gcc_settlements.notes: Inventory for areas outside Greater Chennai Corporation wards, focused on the OMR → Mahabalipuram corridor and Tambaram / Chengalpattu study AOIs. Combines OSM unmet roads, TNGIS settlements/habitation, OSM walk-beyond-10min, and suburban rail stations. Partial — not official municipal wards; not ridership.

outside_gcc_habitation.notes: Inventory for areas outside Greater Chennai Corporation wards, focused on the OMR → Mahabalipuram corridor and Tambaram / Chengalpattu study AOIs. Combines OSM unmet roads, TNGIS settlements/habitation, OSM walk-beyond-10min, and suburban rail stations. Partial — not official municipal wards; not ridership.

omr_south_rail_stations.notes: OSM railway stations near OMR / south AOIs or outside GCC.

realtime.name: GTFS Realtime — Vehicle Positions
realtime.would_unlock: Live bus/metro positions for traffic coordination at hubs and corridors.
realtime.how_to_plug: Set GTFS_RT_VEHICLE_URL env var to an agency GTFS-RT protobuf endpoint.

realtime.name: GTFS Realtime — Trip Updates / Arrivals
realtime.would_unlock: Arrival reliability and delay heatmaps for policy and operations.
realtime.how_to_plug: Set GTFS_RT_TRIP_URL env var when MTC/CMRL publish a feed.

realtime.name: Station Crowding / Incidents API
realtime.would_unlock: Dynamic feeder priority during peaks; incident awareness for traffic dept.
realtime.how_to_plug: Configure AGENCY_CROWD_API_URL when an official API is available.

unavailable_analytics.name: SEC / slum amenity proxy (not income)
unavailable_analytics.reason: SEC proxy combines Census 2011 houselisting amenity/asset percentages (wards 1–155 by number) with OpenCity slum polygon area share on 2022 wards. This is NOT household income or official poverty status. Ward renumbering/expansion means amenity joins are indicative — 155 of 200 wards received HH-14 attributes; 153 wards intersect mapped slum polygons.
unavailable_analytics.needed: Validated Census 2011 (or newer) attributes joined to GCC 2022 ward geometries.

unavailable_analytics.name: Population-weighted % within 400m of transit
unavailable_analytics.reason: Population from Census 2011 ward tables (historic 155-ward scheme) joined to GCC 2022 wards by ward number where labels match. People within 400m estimated as population × geometry catchment share — not a dasymetric surface. Joined 155 of 200 wards.
unavailable_analytics.needed: Validated population surface for all 200 GCC 2022 wards (current join uses Census 2011 ward numbers).

unavailable_analytics.name: CMRL proposed / Phase-II metro stations
unavailable_analytics.reason: OpenCity hosts Phase-II EIA PDFs, not machine-readable station points. Walk-distance access currently uses existing GTFS stops + MRTS/metro-named hubs only.
unavailable_analytics.needed: Verified GeoJSON/KML of proposed CMRL station locations (with corridor/phase tags).
